## Requirements: Network-aware incremental HTTP probing and connection recovery

### Background / verified baseline

User reports that switching Wi-Fi/mobile/VPN networks can leave the current Nession page spinning indefinitely instead of selecting a newly available connection. Requested behavior: re-probe on return to the page and meaningful lifecycle events; periodic refresh defaults to **5 minutes, configurable**; use a lightweight HTTP endpoint instead of opening WS for measurement; independent asynchronous candidate results must immediately update state and trigger recovery when useful, without waiting for slow siblings. Reachability unchanged means retain existing strategy; reachability changed means recompute it. Healthy connections should not be disrupted by latency jitter.

Static baseline main @ `268b973d03e51dac13bff909af0ca38725921f68`:
- [addressSelection.ts:21-105](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/268b973d03e51dac13bff909af0ca38725921f68/web/src/shared/lib/addressSelection.ts#L21): WS upgrade-only measurement, 3s deadline, Promise.all barrier; timeout leaves CONNECTING socket until browser settles.
- [useAgentProbe.ts:69-109](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/268b973d03e51dac13bff909af0ca38725921f68/web/src/product/agent/hooks/useAgentProbe.ts#L69): address/reprobe fingerprint and component-owned batch results; cache per Agent ID without network scope. [useAddressPlan.ts:46-65](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/268b973d03e51dac13bff909af0ca38725921f68/web/src/shared/hooks/useAddressPlan.ts#L46) trusts old orderedUrls ahead of fresh advertisement.
- [useVisibilityReconnect.ts:28-89](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/268b973d03e51dac13bff909af0ca38725921f68/web/src/app/useVisibilityReconnect.ts#L28): foreground resumes same transport; no online/offline handler here. [useAppConnection.ts:124-173](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/268b973d03e51dac13bff909af0ca38725921f68/web/src/app/useAppConnection.ts#L124) constructs Server WS from one URL, with persistent retry.
- [WebSocketService.ts:169-220](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/268b973d03e51dac13bff909af0ca38725921f68/web/src/platform/socket/WebSocketService.ts#L169) reconnectNow shares existing pending connect; openSocket at line 445 has no independent dial deadline. [AddressAttachPolicy.ts:78-106](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/268b973d03e51dac13bff909af0ca38725921f68/web/src/platform/attach/AddressAttachPolicy.ts#L78) rotates candidates only after retry budget, last ordinary candidate can spend ten retries. [SessionRuntime.ts:1955-2000](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/268b973d03e51dac13bff909af0ca38725921f68/web/src/platform/session-runtime/SessionRuntime.ts#L1955) fresh attach only adopts credential, not address inventory.
- [Agent p2p_router:1401](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/268b973d03e51dac13bff909af0ca38725921f68/crates/nession-agent/src/server/websocket.rs#L1401) already uses Axum HTTP with MCP/Registry and fallback upgrade. No separate probe listener required.

This is a new routing/probe design requirement, not a claim that historical #1213/#1263/#1529/#3358/#2645 acceptance was false. Preserve #1309 single SessionRuntime authority, #3358 credential/liveness recovery, #4290 refresh generation fences and #4431 WS architecture. #4588 LAN HTTPS/WSS is relevant deployment context, not a hard prerequisite for isolated implementation. Actual user's device root cause remains unverified; reproduce with controlled fault injection.

### 1. Architecture and non-goals

Network lifecycle signals → Probe scheduler → bounded per-address HTTP probe → incremental Probe state/event → route policy → existing Server connection owner / SessionRuntime → WebSocketService → authenticated attach + stream reconciliation.

- Network lifecycle owns triggers and network observation epoch, not routing. Probe service owns scheduling, cancellation, candidate measurement, cache and publication. UI hooks only subscribe/trigger, never own background tasks. AddressAttachPolicy (Agent) and existing app Server composition owner decide routes; SessionRuntime retains sole Session attach authority. WebSocketService owns physical dial/handshake, timeout, settlement, generation and bounded retries only; no protocol-specific routing.
- Reuse the existing Server-side probe (Server→Agent) as its own vantage point, never substitute its result for browser→Agent reachability. Relay is end-to-end Server auth + Agent registration/relay readiness, not merely HTTP reachability to Server.
- Keep tmux/session identity, browser identity, terminal parser cursor, stream proof, control lease, input ACK/bounds and explicit disconnect semantics. Do not reload page, recreate Session, add a second global Session state machine, change auth lifetime, open production ingress or rewrite WS message lanes.

### 2. HTTP probe contract

Proposed canonical `GET /probe` on Server and Agent, on existing HTTP listener and TLS authority; `204 No Content`, `Cache-Control: no-store`, fixed lightweight response marker e.g. `Nession-Probe: v1` with CORS exposure (distinguish generic proxy/SPA 204). No body, database, tmux, business protocol, token/cookie or auth slot; reuse ingress admission, bounded rate/resource protection, method checks. Return non-success for unavailable service; do not report generic fallback HTML or a redirect as success. Probe success means HTTP path responded, not peer identity or WS upgrade/auth/Session readiness.
- Browser uses fetch GET, credentials omit, cache no-store, redirect error, AbortController; measure monotonic elapsed time until validated headers. Cold/warm HTTP timing is not pure RTT or comparable to old WS upgrade latency; label measurement kind and do not claim guaranteed faster WAN performance. Repeated failure may be policy/CORS/TLS/mixed content indistinguishable in browser; report unknown/blocked where known, otherwise no response in this observation, not proof that network is physically down. No no-cors opaque response treated as success.
- Provide explicit probe_url in canonical address/attach contract (optional additive field for rolling compatibility); advertise only owner-approved HTTP(S) endpoint corresponding to actual WS ingress, including custom reverse proxy path/prefix. Do not blindly replace scheme/path, follow arbitrary redirect or send credentials to untrusted origins; only probe validated advertised/configured candidates. For old peers without probe support, use bounded existing WS upgrade probe only as explicit compatibility path, cancel immediately on deadline; unsupported/CORS failures must not remove potentially working WS candidate. Preserve HTTPS/WSS, CORS origin policy, private-network access requirements and ingress security; handle OPTIONS if needed under existing origin rules, no credentialed wildcard. No public route exposing host/session/Agent identity. Verify TLS and existing WS auth before granting any authority; alternate Server addresses must be explicitly configured/trusted same logical Server, never send saved auth token to arbitrary discovered host. Without trusted alternate Server, continue bounded retry of configured origin. New endpoint reservation must avoid collisions with configured MCP/Registry/WS paths.
- Use existing protocol contract owner and codegen/Gates for additive address fields; test mixed-version clients/servers/agents. Document reverse proxy ingress requirements; no deployment changes required unless separately authorized.

### 3. Scheduling and state

Default periodic interval = 300000 ms (5 minutes), configurable through existing client settings owner/persistence; allow disabling periodic probing without disabling event-driven recovery. Only active Server and active/attached Agent targets (plus explicit visible detail/Retest requests); no whole fleet polling. Suspend periodic work when hidden, immediately refresh on foreground return/pageshow; first entry, online, supported network-change signal, address inventory change, transport loss, bounded retry failure and manual Retry/Retest trigger refresh. Offline suspends routine work, online wakes immediately. Browser network hints are best-effort (not guaranteed on iOS/VPN); actual transport liveness/failure provides fallback. Foreground re-probe even same URL list. Debounce/coalesce repeated signals (proposed 500ms), one effective flight per target/address, no storm on repeated errors; failures within same episode cannot endlessly reset retry budgets. Healthy sockets get existing app-level liveness check, not forced tear-down on hint.

Proposed initial tunables (not measured SLO): HTTP deadline 3s per candidate, global concurrency 8 / per target 4, WS dial deadline 5s plus existing bounded authentication; fast retry max 2 before rotation/reassessment when alternates exist, background failure recovery 15–60s jittered while visible, distinct from 5min healthy maintenance. Use monotonic deadlines, configurable/clamped finite bounds and lifecycle cancellation. Deadline/late callbacks settle once; cleanup timers, request controllers, sockets, pending waiters on supersede/unmount/logout. Explicit disconnect stops recovery; no background retries after logout. Long background timers may be throttled; resume immediately when foreground. No need to identify SSID or collect IP.

State model (names illustrative):
```ts
type Reachability = 'unknown' | 'reachable' | 'unreachable';
interface AddressProbeState {
  targetId: string; addressId: string;
  wsUrl: string; probeUrl?: string;
  inventoryGeneration: number; networkEpoch: number; probeGeneration: number;
  probing: boolean;
  reachability: Reachability;
  latencyMs: number | null;
  measuredAt: number | null; lastReachableAt: number | null;
  method: 'http' | 'legacy-ws';
  failureReason?: string;
}
```
State key scoped by logical Server/Agent + normalized candidate identity; use current inventory as membership authority. Keep last result and measuredAt while new round pending; mark freshness separately (old epoch/expired result only advisory). Never infer pending/unknown as unreachable. Changes to inventory, target, network observation or user route intent fence obsolete results; stale request finally cannot clear a newer task. Probe generation increments per refresh; network epoch advances only on meaningful invalidation, not each timer or retry. Per-address completion publishes immediately to store and policy (previous effective result → new result), not Promise.all gate; aggregate round-completed event only for diagnostics/all-failed verdict. Queued or slow candidates continue after first successful connection. Cancel on actual supersession or target retirement, not simply because another address wins. Single-flight/coalescing spans React subscribers and multiple Sessions sharing target. A new explicit Retest must refresh unchanged addresses, without requiring remount.

### 4. Connection policy and state transitions

Separate probe observation from transport authority. Store per-route actual authenticated WS failure/cooldown and current connection health, in addition to probe results; a successful HTTP probe never clears a WS failure budget automatically. Confirmed authenticated healthy route is stronger evidence than HTTP failure; only transport health failure (or explicit user switch) can retire healthy route. Route plan is recomputed when membership/reachability changes, not merely latency movement. Keep a new plan even while healthy socket retained. Update ranking on latency changes for future decisions only. No automatic latency-driven migration, including healthy Relay→P2P, in this scope. Manual pinned route remains pinned; display alternatives, offer existing Auto selection, no silent fallback. Explicit Relay remains Relay.

| Event/condition | Decision |
|---|---|
| healthy current WS, probe results unchanged or only latency changed | update state, preserve socket generation |
| healthy WS, another candidate changes reachability | recompute standby plan, keep current healthy socket |
| disconnected + first fresh eligible reachable candidate | immediately start bounded dial/auth without waiting for any other probe |
| dialing old candidate + new eligible reachable alternative and old path has failed/expired or confirmed unavailable | cancel stale dial (generation fence), select available route; do not preempt healthy or progressing viable dial on each sample |
| reachability unchanged + current connection lost | retain existing candidate order/retry episode; bounded rotate after real failure, never infinite same-route lock |
| HTTP reachable but WS fails/auth timeout | record WS failure, cooldown/rotate; explicit auth refusal follows existing fail-closed semantics |
| all probes settled with no usable route or all actual dial attempts exhausted | explicit unavailable/degraded state, low-frequency recovery and manual Retry; unknown/legacy candidates may still receive bounded WS attempts |
| latest Server-authenticated-ready | refresh full AttachInfo/inventory (not token only), reconcile same Session, resume appropriate P2P or Relay |
| later slow probe completes after successful attach | publish result, update future plan only |

Single recovery owner per logical Server and Session; a candidate result is a wakeup, not an independent attach call. Serialize decisions, guard network/inventory/route/transport generations; one authoritative winner and one attach/control lease, close losing or retired sockets, settle in-flight requests exactly once. New fast route can begin while slow probes are still running; preserve real connection safety/terminal continuity. For Auto choose best currently usable candidate by existing preference/priority and latest facts, not wait for theoretical fastest. Relay can recover when authenticated Server and Agent route are ready without waiting on all P2P probes; do not use server HTTP alone as relay proof. On fresh AttachInfo, reconcile membership and token atomically through runtime owner, remove old-only addresses and do not let React stale orderedUrls overwrite current inventory. If Server not available, cached approved addresses may be attempted with valid credentials, resume full discovery when Server authenticates. Preserve independent healthy P2P where Server loss alone does not require teardown.

### 5. User-visible behavior and observability

Preserve existing ConnectionStatus/Workspace/Terminal surfaces; compact status distinguishes reconnecting, unavailable/awaiting network and auth refusal. After finite foreground attempt budget, stop indefinite spinner while leaving background recovery running. Keep last-known Session lifecycle, xterm and work surface mounted; manual retry now refreshes current relevant probe/inventory + wakes recovery, without requiring page reload. Existing address detail/Retest displays per-address pending marker alongside last result, measuredAt, method and reason; updates individually. No new permanent dashboard or navigation.

Bounded diagnostics emitted by existing owners: trigger enum, probe result/method/duration, timeout/cancel, queue high-water, reachability-change count, selected route kind, dial/auth/attach timing and failure class, recovery episode and generation correlation (no URL, IP, token, raw Session/Agent IDs in metric labels, no credential payload). Reuse #4437 metric/diagnostic policy. Benchmark on identical controlled cold/warm workload with fixed candidate delay and timeout, record sample count and p50/p95, pending WS slots and time-to-first-usable/attach; no unmeasured latency promise.

### 6. Implementation sequence (one requirement, no unnecessary dependencies)

1. HTTP probe endpoint + advertisement/compatibility + HTTP route tests; reserve path, CORS/TLS/ingress negative tests.
2. React-free per-address scheduler/state, network lifecycle and configurable 5-minute interval; migrate current useAgentProbe/addressSelection consumers and remove duplicate schedulers/batch barrier from decision path.
3. WebSocket dial deadline/abort and generation settlement; integrate latest attach inventory and incremental events into AddressAttachPolicy/SessionRuntime and app Server owner. Keep current WS lane contracts.
4. Existing UI status/Retry/Retest, diagnostics and regression; update canonical docs/knowledge with verified behavior. Use nearest AGENTS/skills, codegen and existing Gates. Implement in isolated worktree; no production changes as part of issue authoring.

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 Server and Agent HTTP probes return validated 204 without business/auth/tmux work or pending-auth allocation; no credentials, cache/redirect false positives, unsafe origin exposure or ingress bypass; additive probe metadata and bounded legacy fallback preserve existing WS clients.
- [ ] SC-02 With deterministic clock, healthy visible target probes every 300000ms by default, configured interval/disable applies; foreground, online, address change, transport loss and manual refresh trigger immediate coalesced probes even unchanged URLs; hidden periodic and retired/logout tasks stop, no whole-fleet poll.
- [ ] SC-03 Controlled fast candidate A and delayed candidate B: A completion writes state and starts eligible recovery before B settles; B continues and writes its own result; per-address and global in-flight bounds hold, including superseded/aborted tasks; stale epoch/inventory/target results cannot overwrite new state.
- [ ] SC-04 Unchanged reachability/latency-only updates preserve existing strategy and healthy physical generation; changed reachability or membership recomputes standby plan; failed old route with newly reachable candidate advances promptly; late probe after recovery never forces healthy migration; manual pin/explicit Relay respected.
- [ ] SC-05 Physical CONNECTING with no browser callbacks settles by configured dial deadline; network/route supersession cancels old connect and rejects waiters exactly once; real WS failure despite HTTP success rotates/cools down and does not reset budget on HTTP success; explicit auth rejection remains fail-closed.
- [ ] SC-06 Fresh AttachInfo with same Session ID but changed addresses replaces stale candidate membership, retains valid credential lifecycle and ignores late stale refresh; Server alternate candidates restricted to explicitly trusted same-server config; no token sent by probe or to untrusted candidate.
- [ ] SC-07 Controlled Chromium visible/foreground/offline/online and slow-candidate scenario shows incremental reachability, preserves Workspace/xterm and existing Session ID, exits spinner when all recovery budgets exhausted, manual Retry triggers rediscovery; successful recovery needs no page reload/login.
- [ ] SC-08 Controlled measurements record baseline WS vs HTTP probe cold/warm times and resource occupancy, sample count and exact runner/SHA; HTTP probes create zero WS pending-auth slots; fast path starts before slow timeout, bounded queues/tasks settle after cancellation. No invented production SLO.
- [ ] SC-09 Isolated integrated Server+Agent+tmux runtime fault injection: LAN path removed, alternate P2P or Relay remains available, same Session resumes without duplicate attach/lease, terminal output/input reconciliation remains correct; later slow probe cannot disrupt recovered transport; all paths down then restored also recovers. Include Server loss/recovery and fresh inventory change. 
- [ ] SC-10 Canonical Web/WS architecture, address/probe contract and connection-status guidance reflect implemented ownership/compatibility and actual behavior; affected knowledge updated via trusted ledger workflow or explicitly justified no change; redacted bounded diagnostic events distinguish probe/WS/auth/attach failures and never include secret material.

### Verification design

SC → scenario: SC-01/02/04/06 = SCN-01 deterministic contract/negative fixtures (exact-head Rust/TS integration and policy fake-clock tests); SC-03/08 = SCN-06 controlled concurrency/timing and resource measurement (fixed fast/slow fixture, counters, bounded cleanup, no production SLA); SC-05 = SCN-03 exact-head executed transport fault fixtures; SC-07 = SCN-02 Chromium browser Case; SC-09 = SCN-03 integrated protocol/runtime Case; SC-10 = SCN-08 source-aligned docs/knowledge links and diagnostic contract negative test. Use existing approved isolated CI and Case Smoke evidence at PR head (Agent evaluates authenticated receipts, not prose), plus targeted merged staging browser/runtime Cases for composition with actual Server/Agent/tmux; no live production credentials/native mobile claim. Existing #3358 browser/protocol Case lane and terminal-consistency-faults suite demonstrate feasible proof path. SC-07/09 staged cases prove assembled integration and route switching after components converge; no Full E2E requirement. For browser failure simulation use controlled candidate endpoints/network interception and real full-stack where appropriate, not physical iOS/Safari claim. Each Case must assert observable transition, exact generation/session/lease and teardown, with source SHA/run/attempt.

## Prototype

- **Decision:** Not needed for current scope: preserve existing ConnectionStatus, address detail and Retry/Retest surfaces; change recovery semantics and truthful state only, not new interaction model. Existing baseline docs/design/design-system/patterns/connection-status.md. Expected scenario: user returns to existing work, observes incremental address status and automatic recovery without reload. If implementation proposes new persistent recovery UI or configuration interaction outside existing settings, re-evaluate and pin verified prototype before acceptance. No new prototype claimed.

### Knowledge Impact

- Decision: Update
- Related knowledge: docs/architecture/web.md, docs/architecture/websocket-runtime.md, docs/architecture/protocol.md, docs/design/design-system/patterns/connection-status.md; knowledge branch topics/engineering/websocket-runtime-observability-and-reliability.md and nession-websocket-runtime-architecture-and-message-dispatch.md; #3358/#1309/#4437.
- Reason: distinguish reachability observation, route selection and physical connection health; document incremental state, generation/timeout/compatibility ownership and evidence.
- Owner and timing: implementation owner updates canonical docs before source-aligned acceptance; knowledge owner reconciles affected articles with exact implementation evidence using trusted ledger path, no manual untrusted publication. If no existing article needs change, document grounded decision.
- Evidence: current main baseline and source links above; future exact PR SHA/CI evidence and knowledge ledger readback pending.

## Product alignment

- [x] VISION.md: continuous work across network boundaries; retain Session.
- [x] PRINCIPLE.md: quiet recovery, progressive disclosure, no unnecessary permanent UI.
- [x] PRODUCT.md and existing connection-status pattern checked; 1.x Session/Workspace continuity.
- [x] Preserve single owner, fail-closed auth, terminal consistency; no deviations requested.

---
**Status:** Approved — user requested detailed design and Issue; implementation, benchmarks, controlled acceptance and real-device diagnosis pending. Proposed defaults other than explicit 5-minute interval are initial engineering choices to validate, not production measurements.
